title: Beyond Successful Robot Demonstrations: Learning from Human Interactions and Modeling Failure Dynamics
title_zh: 超越成功的机器人演示：从人类互动中学习并建模失败动态

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种结合人类互动学习与失败感知后训练的动作条件化世界模型，以改善机器人对失败动态的建模能力。 Action-conditioned world models offer a promising foundation for generalist robotic intelligence by predicting the consequences of actions. However, existing robotic datasets provide limited coverage of the diverse interaction dynamics required for generalizable world modeling. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer complementary interaction experience, yet the embodiment gap between human hands and robotic manipulators hinders effective cross-embodiment learning. Meanwhile, the predominance of successful demonstrations leaves failure dynamics substantially underrepresented, limiting the ability of world models to anticipate unsuccessful executions. To address these limitations, we introduce HF-WM, an action-conditioned world model that combines Human interaction learning with Failure-aware post-training. To bridge the embodiment gap, we develop a dual-branch framework that couples video generation with auxiliary pointflow prediction, using stabilized pointflow as a unified motion representation across human and robot interactions while suppressing egocentric camera motion. To improve failure modeling, we further perform Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training on perturbed actions derived from successful demonstrations, guided by action alignment and physical plausibility rewards, enabling the model to learn plausible failure dynamics without paired ground-truth videos. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HF-WM achieves state-of-the-art performance in action-conditioned video generation and exhibits strong utility for policy evaluation in downstream robotic tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种结合人类互动学习与失败感知后训练的动作条件化世界模型，以改善机器人对失败动态的建模能力。动作条件化世界模型通过预测动作的后果，为通用机器人智能提供了有前景的基础。 然而，现有的机器人数据集对实现可泛化的世界建模所必需的多样化互动动态覆盖有限。 大规模的第一人称视角人类视频提供了补充性的互动经验，但人类双手与机器人操作器之间的具身化差异阻碍了有效的跨具身化学习。 同时，成功演示的占主导地位导致失败动态严重不足，限制了世界模型预测执行失败的能力。 为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 HF-WM——一种结合人类互动学习与失败感知后训练的动作条件化世界模型。 为了弥合具身化差异，我们开发了一个双分支框架，将视频生成与辅助的点流预测相结合，利用稳定的点流作为人类与机器人互动中的统一运动表示，同时抑制第一人称视角的相机运动。 为提升失败建模能力，我们还对源自成功演示的扰动动作执行了群体相对策略优化（GRPO）后训练，该过程由动作对齐和物理合理性奖励引导，使模型无需配对的真实视频也能学习合理的失败动态。 广泛的实验表明，HF-WM 在动作条件化视频生成方面达到了当前最优性能，并在下游机器人任务中展现出强大的策略评估能力。
